overview.about: The Youth Olympic Games are the International Olympic Committee's event for 15-to-18-year-old athletes, blending elite junior competition with cultural and education programmes. Created in 2010, they are a proving ground for the next generation of Olympians. The 2027 Winter edition is held in Gangneung, South Korea.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 Winter Youth Olympic Games take place in Gangneung, South Korea, using venues from the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympics. Athletes aged 15 to 18 compete across winter sports alongside a learn-and-share programme.

@graph.name: Youth Olympic Games
@graph.description: Gangwon 2024 was the fourth Winter Youth Olympic Games and ran from 19 January to 1 February in South Korea. Competitions were based around Gangneung and other Gangwon Province venues that had also been used for the 2018 Winter Olympics. Olympics.com provides the official event archive, sports programme and results.
